gloss: one's own book; one's own written work

definitions.gloss: one's own book; one's own publication; a book one has written
definitions.explanation: A book or written work authored by the person being discussed. Used when referring to someone's own published writing, especially in literary, academic, or media contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自著|じちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}した→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The professor introduced their own book.

examples.japanese: {自著|じちょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サイン→サイン：03846_sain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{読者|どくしゃ}→読者：16554_dokusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: They signed their own book and handed it to the reader.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自著|じちょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{語|かた}っている→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: That author talks in detail about their own experiences in their book.

notes:
A compound of {自|じ} (self) and {著|ちょ} (written work, publication). Specifically refers to a book or publication that one has personally authored, as opposed to books by others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自著|じちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to publish one's own book
- {自著|じちょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce one's own book
- {自著|じちょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインする→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧: to sign one's own book
- {自著|じちょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in one's own book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{著書|ちょしょ}→著書：14083_chosho⟧: written work, book — can refer to anyone's published book; {自著|じちょ} specifically means the speaker's or subject's own book
- ⟦{著作|ちょさく}→著作：18234_chosaku⟧: literary work, writing — broader term that includes any kind of authored content, not just books
- {拙著|せっちょ}: my humble work — a modest way to refer to one's own book; uses the self-deprecating prefix {拙|せつ}

REGISTER:
Formal. Commonly appears in interviews, book reviews, academic introductions, and literary discussion. In casual conversation, people would more naturally say ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん} (my own book).
